task.title: Nutrition on recipes, with day and week totals and personal targets
task.description:
Owner decisions (2026-11-18):
- Numeric nutrition on every recipe; estimated on import when the page has none.
- Targets start blank; each user sets their own. One line says figures are estimates and not medical advice. No built-in defaults.

Wanted:
- Per-serving nutrition fields on a recipe (calories, protein, carbs, fat, fibre, saturated fat, sodium), editable, with a marker when a figure is an estimate.
- Import stores the page's nutrition when present.
- Planner: per-slot calories and protein, day totals and a week view, counting Cook slots, Leftovers via their source, and Eat out meals that have numbers. Slots with no numbers are shown as not counted.
- A targets setting, and markers against targets on day totals.
- Estimates are labelled wherever numbers appear.

Notes: depends on the AI helper story for estimating missing numbers. Portions follow the grocery rule (people, leftovers). Feeds the MacroFactor idea later.
